description: A report submitted when a piece of equipment or a facility is found faulty.

equipment_id.rule: 3-32 chars, letters/digits/hyphen only, normalised to uppercase

reporter_id.rule: 3-32 chars, synthetic ID only -- no real personal data

error_response_example.detail: One or more fields failed validation.

idempotency_note: Each submission creates a new ticket_id; duplicate-detection by content is out of scope for the MVP and is listed as a limitation in the report.

status_update_event.auth: X-Maintenance-Key header, must equal the MAINTENANCE_API_KEY environment variable
status_update_event.note: This amends the original FaultReport contract, which stated no field changes after creation. See the decision record for why and what this intentionally does not include (no per-user accounts, no audit trail beyond the structured log).
